# Gean Paulo: Links

> Official link hub for Gean Paulo (Gean Paulo Paguirigan), a web designer and front-end developer based in Manila, Philippines. This page lists every official Gean Paulo profile and contact channel in one place, maintained by Gean Paulo himself.

Gean Paulo designs and builds modern, interactive, user-friendly web experiences. He is available for freelance projects: websites, landing pages, GoHighLevel (GHL) automations, logo and branding, graphic design, and SEO. His portfolio with selected work and services is at geanpaulo.com.

- [Gean Paulo Portfolio](https://geanpaulo.com): Primary website and portfolio with selected projects, services, and about.
